description: This Java class defines a conditional component for the Fineract framework that checks environment properties related to different operational modes (read, write, batch manager, batch worker). It implements Spring's Condition interface to determine if certain modes are enabled, logging an error if none are enabled.

classes.name: FineractModeValidationCondition
classes.description: A Spring condition class that validates whether at least one of the Fineract mode environment variables is enabled. If none are enabled, it logs an error and returns true, indicating the condition does not match the expected environment.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Evaluates if the environment variable configuration for Fineract modes is valid (at least one mode enabled). Logs an error if validation fails. Returns a boolean indicating whether the condition matches.
